description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Nyx Lotus and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Nyx Lotus and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Nyx Lotus and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.
